017package org.apache.juneau.marshall.objecttools;
018
019import static java.time.temporal.ChronoField.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.lang.StateEnum.*;
021import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
022
023import java.time.*;
024import java.util.*;
025
026import org.apache.juneau.commons.lang.*;

030/**
031 * Date/time matcher factory for the {@link ObjectSearcher} class.
032 *
033 * <p>
034 *    The class provides searching based on the following patterns:
035 * </p>
036 * <ul>
037 *    <li><js>"property=2011"</js> - A single year
038 *    <li><js>"property=2011 2013 2015"</js> - Multiple years
039 *    <li><js>"property=2011-01"</js> - A single month
040 *    <li><js>"property=2011-01-01"</js> - A single day
041 *    <li><js>"property=2011-01-01T12"</js> - A single hour
042 *    <li><js>"property=2011-01-01T12:30"</js> - A single minute
043 *    <li><js>"property=2011-01-01T12:30:45"</js> - A single second
044 *    <li><js>"property=&gt;2011"</js>,<js>"property=&gt;=2011"</js>,<js>"property=&lt;2011"</js>,<js>"property=&lt;=2011"</js> - Open-ended ranges
045 *    <li><js>"property=&gt;2011"</js>,<js>"property=&gt;=2011"</js>,<js>"property=&lt;2011"</js>,<js>"property=&lt;=2011"</js> - Open-ended ranges
046 *    <li><js>"property=2011 - 2013-06-30"</js> - Closed ranges
047 * </ul>
048 *
049 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
050 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/ObjectTools">Object Tools</a>
051 * </ul>
052 */
053public class TimeMatcherFactory extends MatcherFactory {
054
055   /**
056    * A construct representing a single search pattern.
057    */
058   private static class TimeMatcher extends AbstractMatcher {
059
060      private static final AsciiSet DT = AsciiSet.of("0123456789-:T./");
061      private static final AsciiSet WS = AsciiSet.of(" \t");
062
063      TimestampRange[] ranges;
064      List<TimestampRange> l = ll();
065
066      @SuppressWarnings({
067         "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for parser state machine
068         "java:S135" // Multiple break statements necessary for state machine error handling
069      })
070      public TimeMatcher(String s) {
071
072         // Possible patterns:
073         // >2000, <2000, >=2000, <=2000, > 2000, 2000 - 2001, '2000', >'2000', '2000'-'2001', '2000' - '2001'
074
075         // Possible states:
076         // S1 = Looking for [<]/[>]/quote/NUM ([>]=S2, [<]=S3, [']=S5, ["]=S6, NUM=S8)
077         // S2 = Found [>], looking for [=]/quote/NUM ([=]=S4, [']=S5, ["]=S6, NUM=S8)
078         // S3 = Found [<], looking for [=]/quote/NUM ([=]=S4, [']=S5, ["]=S6, NUM=S8)
079         // S4 = Found [>=] or [<=], looking for quote/NUM ([']=S5, ["]=S6, NUM=S8)
080         // S5 = Found ['], looking for ['] ([']=S1)
081         // S6 = Found ["], looking for ["] (["]=S1)
082         // S7 = Found [123"] or [123'], looking for WS (WS=S9)
083         // S8 = Found [2], looking for WS (WS=S9)
084         // S9 = Found [2000 ], looking for [-]/quote/NUM ([-]=S10, [']=S11, ["]=S12, NUM=S13)
085         // S10 = Found [2000 -], looking for quote/NUM ([']=S11, ["]=S12, NUM=S13)
086         // S11 = Found [2000 - '], looking for ['] ([']=S1)
087         // S12 = Found [2000 - "], looking for ["] (["]=S1)
088         // S13 = Found [2000 - 2], looking for WS (WS=S1)
089
090         var state = S1;
091         var mark = 0;
092         var eq = Equality.NONE;
093         String s1 = null;
094         String s2 = null;
095
096         int i;
097         char c = 0;
098         for (i = 0; i < s.trim().length(); i++) {
099            c = s.charAt(i);
100            if (state == S1) {
101               // S1 = Looking for [>]/[<]/quote/NUM ([>]=S2, [<]=S3, [']=S5, ["]=S6, NUM=S8)
102               if (WS.contains(c)) {
103                  state = S1;
104               } else if (c == '>') {
105                  state = S2;
106                  eq = Equality.GT;
107               } else if (c == '<') {
108                  state = S3;
109                  eq = Equality.LT;
110               } else if (c == '\'') {
111                  state = S5;
112                  mark = i + 1;
113               } else if (c == '"') {
114                  state = S6;
115                  mark = i + 1;
116               } else if (DT.contains(c)) {
117                  state = S8;
118                  mark = i;
119               } else {
120                  break;
121               }
122            } else if (state == S2) {
123               // S2 = Found [>], looking for [=]/quote/NUM ([=]=S4, [']=S5, ["]=S6, NUM=S8)
124               if (WS.contains(c)) {
125                  state = S2;
126               } else if (c == '=') {
127                  state = S4;
128                  eq = Equality.GTE;
129               } else if (c == '\'') {
130                  state = S5;
131                  mark = i + 1;
132               } else if (c == '"') {
133                  state = S6;
134                  mark = i + 1;
135               } else if (DT.contains(c)) {
136                  state = S8;
137                  mark = i;
138               } else {
139                  break;
140               }
141            } else if (state == S3) {
142               // S3 = Found [<], looking for [=]/quote/NUM ([=]=S4, [']=S5, ["]=S6, NUM=S8)
143               if (WS.contains(c)) {
144                  state = S3;
145               } else if (c == '=') {
146                  state = S4;
147                  eq = Equality.LTE;
148               } else if (c == '\'') {
149                  state = S5;
150                  mark = i + 1;
151               } else if (c == '"') {
152                  state = S6;
153                  mark = i + 1;
154               } else if (DT.contains(c)) {
155                  state = S8;
156                  mark = i;
157               } else {
158                  break;
159               }
160            } else if (state == S4) {
161               // S4 = Found [>=] or [<=], looking for quote/NUM ([']=S5, ["]=S6, NUM=S8)
162               if (WS.contains(c)) {
163                  state = S4;
164               } else if (c == '\'') {
165                  state = S5;
166                  mark = i + 1;
167               } else if (c == '"') {
168                  state = S6;
169                  mark = i + 1;
170               } else if (DT.contains(c)) {
171                  state = S8;
172                  mark = i;
173               } else {
174                  break;
175               }
176            } else if (state == S5) {
177               // S5 = Found ['], looking for ['] ([']=S7)
178               if (c == '\'') {
179                  state = S7;
180                  s1 = s.substring(mark, i);
181               }
182            } else if (state == S6) {
183               // S6 = Found ["], looking for ["] (["]=S7)
184               if (c == '"') {
185                  state = S7;
186                  s1 = s.substring(mark, i);
187               }
188            } else if (state == S7) {
189               // S7 = Found [123"] or [123'], looking for WS (WS=S9)
190               if (WS.contains(c)) {
191                  state = S9;
192               } else if (c == '-') {
193                  state = S10;
194               } else {
195                  break;
196               }
197            } else if (state == S8) {
198               // S8 = Found [1], looking for WS (WS=S9)
199               if (WS.contains(c)) {
200                  state = S9;
201                  s1 = s.substring(mark, i);
202               }
203            } else if (state == S9) {
204               // S9 = Found [2000 ], looking for [-]/[>]/[<]/quote/NUM ([-]=S10, [>]=S2, [<]=S3, [']=S5, ["]=S6, NUM=S8)
205               if (WS.contains(c)) {
206                  state = S9;
207               } else if (c == '-') {
208                  state = S10;
209               } else if (c == '>') {
210                  state = S2;
211                  l.add(new TimestampRange(eq, s1));
212                  eq = Equality.GT;
213                  s1 = null;
214               } else if (c == '<') {
215                  state = S3;
216                  l.add(new TimestampRange(eq, s1));
217                  eq = Equality.LT;
218                  s1 = null;
219               } else if (c == '\'') {
220                  state = S5;
221                  l.add(new TimestampRange(eq, s1));
222                  mark = i + 1;
223                  eq = null;
224                  s1 = null;
225               } else if (c == '"') {
226                  state = S6;
227                  l.add(new TimestampRange(eq, s1));
228                  mark = i + 1;
229                  eq = null;
230                  s1 = null;
231               } else if (DT.contains(c)) {
232                  state = S8;
233                  l.add(new TimestampRange(eq, s1));
234                  eq = null;
235                  s1 = null;
236                  mark = i;
237               } else {
238                  break;
239               }
240            } else if (state == S10) {
241               // S10 = Found [2000 -], looking for quote/NUM ([']=S11, ["]=S12, NUM=S13)
242               if (WS.contains(c)) {
243                  state = S10;
244               } else if (c == '\'') {
245                  state = S11;
246                  mark = i + 1;
247               } else if (c == '"') {
248                  state = S12;
249                  mark = i + 1;
250               } else if (DT.contains(c)) {
251                  state = S13;
252                  mark = i;
253               } else {
254                  break;
255               }
256            } else if (state == S11) {
257               // S11 = Found [2000 - '], looking for ['] ([']=S1)
258               if (c == '\'') {
259                  state = S1;
260                  s2 = s.substring(mark, i);
261                  l.add(new TimestampRange(s1, s2));
262                  s1 = null;
263                  s2 = null;
264               }
265            } else if (state == S12) {
266               // S12 = Found [2000 - "], looking for ["] (["]=S1)
267               if (c == '"') {
268                  state = S1;
269                  s2 = s.substring(mark, i);
270                  l.add(new TimestampRange(s1, s2));
271                  s1 = null;
272                  s2 = null;
273               }
274            } else /* (state == S13) */ {
275               // S13 = Found [2000 - 2], looking for WS (WS=S1)
276               if (WS.contains(c)) {
277                  state = S1;
278                  s2 = s.substring(mark, i);
279                  l.add(new TimestampRange(s1, s2));
280                  s1 = null;
281                  s2 = null;
282               }
283            }
284         }
285
286         if (i != s.length())
287            throw new PatternException("Invalid range pattern (%s): pattern=[%s], pos=[%s], char=[%s]", state, s, i, c);
288
289         if (state == S1) {
290            // No tokens found.
291         } else if (state == S2 || state == S3 || state == S4 || state == S5 || state == S6 || state == S10 || state == S11 || state == S12) {
292            throw new PatternException("Invalid range pattern (E%s): %s", state, s);
293         } else if (state == S7) {
294            l.add(new TimestampRange(eq, s1));
295         } else if (state == S8) {
296            s1 = s.substring(mark).trim();
297            l.add(new TimestampRange(eq, s1));
298         } else /* (state == S13) */ {
299            s2 = s.substring(mark).trim();
300            l.add(new TimestampRange(s1, s2));
301         }
302
303         ranges = l.toArray(new TimestampRange[l.size()]);
304      }
305
306      @Override
307      public boolean matches(ClassMeta<?> cm, Object o) {
308         if (ranges.length == 0)
309            return true;
310
311         ZonedDateTime zdt;
312         if (cm.isCalendar()) {
313            var c = (Calendar)o;
314            zdt = c.toInstant().atZone(c.getTimeZone().toZoneId());
315         } else {
316            var date = (Date)o;
317            zdt = date.toInstant().atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault());
318         }
319         for (var range : ranges)
320            if (range.matches(zdt))
321               return true;
322         return false;
323      }
324   }
325
326   /**
327    * A construct representing a single search range in a single search pattern.
328    * All possible forms of search patterns are boiled down to these timestamp ranges.
329    */
330   private static class TimestampRange {
331      ZonedDateTime start;
332      ZonedDateTime end;
333
334      /**
335       * Constructor for single-bound ranges (e.g. <js>">2001-01-01"</js>, <js>"&lt;2001-01-01"</js>).
336       *
337       * @param eq The comparison operator (e.g. <c>GT</c>, <c>GTE</c>, <c>LT</c>, <c>LTE</c>, <c>NONE</c>).
338       * @param singleDate The granular date/time string defining the bound.
339       */
340      public TimestampRange(Equality eq, String singleDate) {
341         var singleDate1 = GranularZonedDateTime.of(singleDate);
342         if (eq == Equality.GT) {
343            this.start = singleDate1.roll(1).roll(MILLI_OF_SECOND, -1).getZonedDateTime();
344            this.end = Instant.ofEpochMilli(Long.MAX_VALUE).atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault());
345         } else if (eq == Equality.LT) {
346            this.start = Instant.ofEpochMilli(0).atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault());
347            this.end = singleDate1.getZonedDateTime();
348         } else if (eq == Equality.GTE) {
349            this.start = singleDate1.roll(MILLI_OF_SECOND, -1).getZonedDateTime();
350            this.end = Instant.ofEpochMilli(Long.MAX_VALUE).atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault());
351         } else if (eq == Equality.LTE) {
352            this.start = Instant.ofEpochMilli(0).atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault());
353            this.end = singleDate1.roll(1).getZonedDateTime();
354         } else {
355            this.start = singleDate1.copy().roll(MILLI_OF_SECOND, -1).getZonedDateTime();
356            this.end = singleDate1.roll(1).getZonedDateTime();
357         }
358      }
359
360      /**
361       * Constructor for explicit-bound ranges (e.g. <js>"2001-01-01-2001-12-31"</js>).
362       *
363       * @param start The granular date/time string defining the start of the range (inclusive).
364       * @param end The granular date/time string defining the end of the range (inclusive).
365       */
366      public TimestampRange(String start, String end) {
367         var start1 = GranularZonedDateTime.of(start);
368         var end1 = GranularZonedDateTime.of(end);
369         this.start = start1.copy().roll(MILLI_OF_SECOND, -1).getZonedDateTime();
370         this.end = end1.roll(1).getZonedDateTime();
371      }
372
373      /**
374       * Checks whether the specified date/time falls within this range.
375       *
376       * @param zdt The date/time to test.
377       * @return <jk>true</jk> if the date/time is within range.
378       */
379      public boolean matches(ZonedDateTime zdt) {
380         return zdt.isAfter(start) && zdt.isBefore(end);
381      }
382   }
383
384   /**
385    * Default reusable matcher.
386    */
387   public static final TimeMatcherFactory DEFAULT = new TimeMatcherFactory();
388
389   /**
390    * Constructor.
391    */
392   protected TimeMatcherFactory() {}
393
394   @Override
395   public boolean canMatch(ClassMeta<?> cm) {
396      return cm.isDateOrCalendar();
397   }
398
399   @Override
400   public AbstractMatcher create(String pattern) {
401      return new TimeMatcher(pattern);
402   }
403}
